title: Media pack fetcher (allow-listed, hash-verified, writes CREDITS.md)
summary: Downloads the direct assets of an agent media pack manifest from allow-listed HTTPS hosts only, verifies or records SHA-256, and writes CREDITS.md and a lock file.
description: Never fetches pages that need a human (fetch.method manual-page), never fetches assets whose redistribution is forbidden (Mixamo, store EULAs), re-checks the allow-list on every redirect, caps file size, writes atomically and refuses hash mismatches. Tests use an injected fake fetcher, so they never touch the network.

side_effects: downloads only assets with fetch.method=direct from allow-listed https hosts (defaults above; --allow-host extends the list)
writes files under --out plus pack.lock.json and CREDITS.md
